shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omadesign · #195 + #194 merged (installer + OmaStore)
shipped.summary: Two merged PRs on main. #195 adds a version-aware installer launch mode so omadesign installs or updates before launching; #194 (community contribution from KitsuneSemCalda) ships the OmaStore manifest stacked on top of it so OmaStore launches omadesign through the official installer.
bullets: Version-aware installer launch mode; verify archive version before replacing an installed app
Repair missing plugin files and check every bundled starter file before fast launch
Package the official OmaStore launch-and-install entry (omastore.toml)
Repair packaged installs and close launch review gaps
